Jeweled Dagger.name: Jeweled Dagger
Jeweled Dagger.description: A short metal blade mounted to a small hilt and crossguard. The dagger makes an effective side armament for hardened warriors or a hidden blade for assassins and thieves.

Unidentified Wand.name: Wand of Magic Detection
Unidentified Wand.description: This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge as an action to cast the @Compendium[dnd5e.spells.ghXTfe7sgCbgf1Q8]{Detect Magic} spell from it. The wand regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

Immovable Greataxe.name: Immovable Greataxe
Immovable Greataxe.description:
This greataxe is not magical, but it has an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.eQNXan0zp279jDtk]{immovable rod} as its shaft. The button to control the rod is within easy reach of anyone using the greataxe as a weapon.

You can use an action to press the button, which causes the greataxe to become magically fixed in place. Until you or another creature uses an action to push the button again, the axe doesn't move, even if it is defying gravity. The axe can hold up to 8,000 pounds of weight. More weight causes the axe to deactivate and fall. A creature can use an action to make a [[/check ability=str dc=30]] check, moving the fixed axe up to 10 feet on a success.

Well Made Shortsword.name: Well Made Shortsword
Well Made Shortsword.description: A medium sized blade with a firm crossguard and a leather-wrapped handle. A versatile weapon which makes up in versatility what it lacks in reach. Its pommel and guard are set with semiprecious stones.

Thieves' Tools.name: Thieves' Tools
Thieves' Tools.description: This set of tools includes a small file, a set of lock picks, a small mirror mounted on a metal handle, a set of narrow-bladed scissors, and a pair of pliers. Proficiency with these tools lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to disarm traps or open locks.
